findings.observation: Types are looked up by string name through the Lighthouse assembly so the file builds before the types exist. Acceptable as a pre-craft device: it makes the failure assert-not-null instead of a compile error, and the wire rows give the semantic RED. As a permanent design it is weak: a rename or move of the rule silently becomes a not-null failure, constructor shape is resolved by reflection, and the registration is rebuilt in the test rather than shared with Program.cs.

Crafter must not edit oracle files, so this is a follow-up for the oracle owner; does not block craft.
